title: A person runs, the drone follows
problem_line: Launch from the station, find a person in a red shirt and jeans by their clothing words, and keep them in view without a pilot.

beats.caption: The drone waits on the station's pad. The request: red shirt, jeans, last seen on Main Street.
Dispatch: take off, fly to the area, fly search legs.
People seen on the way are compared by clothing colour words only. Never a face.
The person starts to jog east, then north up Oak Street. The drone keeps them in frame on its own.
Round the corner onto North Road: still in view, position reported from the pad.

success_line: Matched by clothing, followed round two corners, never on anyone else.
